intro: THE PLANETARY GOVERNOR HAS BEEN SILENT FOR THIRTY DAYS.
THE CHAOS WARBAND OF TZEENTCH HOLDS THE OUTER HIVES.
TYRANID SPLINTER FLEET LEVIATHAN APPROACHES FROM THE DARK.
THE WARP RIFTS. THE SCREAMING NEVER STOPS.
ONE CHANCE REMAINS. ONE RELIC. THE ANATHEMA SHARD.
A FRAGMENT OF THE EMPEROR'S CRYSTALLIZED WILL.
HIDDEN IN THE CITADEL OF SILENCE.
YOU ARE ALL THAT STANDS BETWEEN MORTIS PRIME AND OBLIVION.
THE INQUISITOR WHO BRIEFED YOU WAS KILLED BY A CHAOS SNIPER.
BEFORE HE DIED, HE SAID ONLY THIS:
'FIND THE SHARD. SEAL THE RIFT. ASSUME YOU WON'T COME BACK.'
HE WAS RIGHT ABOUT AT LEAST ONE OF THOSE THINGS.
midpoint: THE IRON KEEP FALLS. ITS SECRETS REMAIN.
THE GOVERNOR'S ARCHIVES TELL A STORY TWO CENTURIES OLD.
LORD GENERAL XERATHUL. HERO OF THE WAR OF MORTIS.
HE MADE A DEAL. WITH TZEENTCH. THE ARCHITECT OF FATE.
SURVIVAL. IN EXCHANGE FOR THE SECTOR. EVENTUALLY.
HE HAS BEEN GIVING MORTIS PRIME TO CHAOS FOR TWO HUNDRED YEARS.
PIECE BY PIECE. DISTRICT BY DISTRICT. SOUL BY SOUL.
HE TOLD HIMSELF IT WAS NECESSARY. THAT HE WAS BUYING TIME.
TIME FOR THE REST OF THE IMPERIUM. FOR HUMANITY.
IT DOESN'T MATTER. BELIEF DOESN'T SANCTIFY BETRAYAL.
THE DAEMON PRINCE AWAITS IN THE CITADEL.
AND NOW YOU KNOW WHAT HE WAS.
before_final_boss: 'YOU UNDERSTAND NOTHING. I SAVED THIS SECTOR FOR TWO HUNDRED YEARS.'
'EVERY SOUL I GAVE TO CHAOS WAS BOUGHT TIME FOR A THOUSAND OTHERS.'
'YOU CALL IT BETRAYAL. I CALL IT MATHEMATICS.'
'THE EMPEROR HIMSELF MAKES SUCH CALCULATIONS ON HIS GOLDEN THRONE.'
'DO NOT PRETEND YOU ARE DIFFERENT FROM ME.'
SOME ARGUMENTS ARE NOT WON WITH WORDS.
ending_choice: THE SHARD IS IN YOUR HANDS.
THE WARP RIFT STRAINS AGAINST ITSELF.
IT WILL CLOSE. BUT SOMEONE MUST HOLD IT SHUT.
THERE IS NO MECHANISM. NO MACHINE. ONLY WILL.
HUMAN WILL, PRESSED AGAINST THE SCREAMING VOID.
OR PERHAPS THERE IS ANOTHER WAY.
